goal: Make agent-archive setup and status easy and pleasant: find what already exists, catch blockers first, explain failures, and look good in the terminal.

prs.title: Add a shared terminal UI layer (colors, symbols, wrap, spinner)
prs.scope: New internal/cli/ui.go with color roles ok (green), warn (yellow), fail (red), cmd (cyan), dim, bold; the symbols ✓ ! ✗; a hanging-indent wrap to terminal width; a spinner that prints nothing when output is not a terminal; and displayPath (~ for home). Move textStyle out of prompt.go. Keep NO_COLOR, TERM=dumb and non-TTY behavior exactly. No screen changes yet.
prs.done: Unit tests for every role with and without color; existing tests unchanged and passing.

prs.title: Golden transcripts for setup and status screens
prs.scope: Drive setup and status through the injected Env and in-memory store (as the existing setup tests do) and record about 12 screens as goldens, in color and with NO_COLOR: fresh Mac with apps and a Git cwd; fresh with no apps; recent-projects list; resume menu; reconfigure menu; storage failure; review (fresh); review (reconfigure with changes); next steps; status ready; status needs attention. Add an -update flag like the repo's other goldens.
prs.done: go test ./internal/cli -run Screens passes; the goldens are readable text with ANSI codes escaped.

prs.title: Classify storage errors into plain causes
prs.scope: A Diagnose(err) function returning a cause (no_credentials, access_denied, no_such_bucket, wrong_region, network, other), a one-sentence explanation, and a fix hint, using the AWS SDK's typed errors. Silence the AWS SDK's own logger so no 'SDK <date> WARN/DEBUG' line reaches the terminal.
prs.done: Table tests for each cause built from real SDK error types; no SDK log output during tests.

prs.title: Show storage failures as a diagnosis, and fix the failure menu
owns: internal/cli/setup.go: the storage-check block in setup() (the verifyStorage call through '✓ Connected')
prs.scope: Print the diagnosis once (red ✗ headline, cause, cyan fix command); raw error text only with a new --verbose flag. The failure menu defaults to the fix (edit storage), not Cancel. After a failed check, set the draft so 'Continue where you left off' reopens storage instead of re-running the same check. Stop printing the error a second time at exit.
prs.done: Goldens for each cause; a test that Continue after an access failure asks for storage.

prs.title: Validate hook files without changing them
prs.scope: A read-only Validate(files) that runs the same parse and duplicate-key checks install uses and returns file, line, column and reason for each problem. It writes nothing.
prs.done: Tests for JSONC comments, trailing commas, BOM, duplicate keys, symlinked files; install behavior unchanged.

prs.title: Preflight before the first question
owns: internal/cli/setup.go: setup() from the start through the other-installation check
prs.scope: Before any question: validate the hook files of every detected app (B1), check launchctl is reachable, and check the Keychain opens when R2 may be used. Print one ✓/✗ line each. A blocker stops setup before question 1 with the file and line to fix. Keep the results for the review screen (F1).
prs.done: A test that a commented settings.json stops setup before any prompt; goldens updated.

prs.title: Better AWS profile defaults
prs.scope: Default to AWS_PROFILE when set. Mark profiles with no credential source (no keys, no credential_process, no sso, no role). Default the provider to S3 when a usable profile exists, R2 otherwise.
prs.done: Tests for each default; discovery still never reads secret values or runs credential_process.

prs.title: List buckets and use the bucket's real region
prs.scope: After the profile is chosen, list its buckets and offer them by number (pre-select one named like agent-archive*). Read the bucket's region with GetBucketLocation and use it. Reject a typed region that is not region-shaped. Fall back to typing when listing is denied.
prs.done: Tests with the in-memory or stub store; a bad region can no longer be saved.

prs.title: Always show recent projects, with counts
prs.scope: Always show the recent-projects list, with the cwd repo pre-selected, and each project's session count (backfill.KnownProject.Sessions already exists). 'a' selects all. Removing the last project re-asks instead of ending setup.
prs.done: Goldens for cwd-in-repo and no-repo; a test that removing every project re-asks.

prs.title: Offer to import past sessions at the end of setup
prs.scope: After a committed setup, when the chosen projects have past sessions: 'Import the N past sessions from these projects? [Y/n]', run backfill in-process, and show its result. Skip when paused. Then print a copy-paste 'agent-archive setup --yes ...' line for another Mac (the R2 secret stays an environment variable, never a flag).
prs.done: Tests for yes, no and nothing-to-import; backfill undo still works on what it imported.

prs.title: Redesign status output
prs.scope: Colored state line; the single most important fix on top; grouped Capture and Storage sections of ✓/! rows; relative times; ~ paths; no internal codes. --json output byte-for-byte unchanged.
prs.done: Goldens for ready, waiting, needs attention, paused; the --json tests unchanged.

prs.title: status --verbose keeps today's detail
prs.scope: --verbose prints everything today's status prints (codes, ISO times, evidence). Update the troubleshooting guide's 'Reading status' section and the CLI reference.
prs.done: cli_reference_test passes; troubleshooting docs match the new output.

prs.title: Review screen as a checklist
prs.scope: Rows: Apps (with versions, 'version not detected' when unknown), Projects, Storage as one s3:// or r2 address, Keep for. Then a ✓/!/✗ checklist fed by preflight and the storage check: storage connected, bucket private, hook files valid, per-app next step. ~ paths. Keep the reconfigure '* changed / was' markers.
prs.done: Goldens for fresh, reconfigure, public bucket and R2.

prs.title: Prompt and next-steps styling
prs.scope: Bold questions and defaults, a consistent '›' cursor, cyan for every command the user types, a spinner on the storage check that resolves to ✓ or ✗ on the same line.
prs.done: Goldens updated; piped input and NO_COLOR output unchanged apart from the text.

prs.title: setup --yes lists every missing answer
prs.scope: Collect every missing or invalid answer (apps, projects, storage) and report them together in one message.
prs.done: Tests for two and three missing answers at once.

prs.title: Setup polish
owns: internal/cli/setup.go: the entry menus and promptStorage's help loop
prs.scope: Add 'Nothing, exit' to the already-set-up menu; no 'Step 1 of 3' header for a single-area edit; keep 'help' working on the second storage menu; hide the 'You'll need a bucket' line when resuming a draft that has one.
